policy: Every value below was read from a publicly accessible page on 2026-10-08. No paywall was bypassed, nothing was bulk-scraped, and no scouting report text is stored: only individual factual rank / grade / ETA values and short DISI paraphrases (<= 500 characters). The 48 legacy MLB Pipeline international ranks with provenance are backfilled by the migration itself from the existing evidence and sources rows, not listed here.

scales.label: 20-80 scouting scale
scales.notes: The traditional scouting scale: 50 is major-league average. A trailing + or - on a source grade (for example FV 45+) is a qualifier, kept separate from the numeric base.

publications.publication_name: MLB Pipeline Top 30 international prospect signings
publications.scope_notes: Annual signing-day tracker ranking the leading international amateur prospects across all clubs (editions 2013 and 2014 in DISI). Ranks are INTERNATIONAL_CLASS scope: not comparable with an organization list or an MLB-wide Top 100.
publications.methodology_notes: MLB Pipeline's own published ranking. DISI has not audited its methodology; MLBAM terms permit only individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use of MLB.com materials.

publications.scope_notes: Per-organization lists ranked with a Future Value (FV) on the 20-80 scale, an ETA, and tool grades published as present/future pairs (some tools as a single value). Rank scope is ORGANIZATION.
publications.methodology_notes: FanGraphs' published columns: Rk, Name, Age, Highest Level, Position, ETA, FV. FanGraphs' terms of use page was not located during the 2026-10-08 audit, so only individual factual values are transcribed and no report text is stored. List pages use rolling URLs and can be edited after publication.

publications.scope_notes: MLB-wide Top 100 prospect list, published annually. Rank scope is MLB_GLOBAL.
publications.methodology_notes: Baseball America's detailed rankings and reports are subscription content; DISI cites only individual ranks reported by free secondary articles and stores no report text.
